Featuring interviews with Lemmy, Nik Turner, Michael Moorcock, Stacia and other Hawkwind alumni, it’s a window into a band where free festivals, naked dancers, cosmic poetry, motorways, and very loud amplifiers all somehow occupied the same universe. Sprague :: The Aquarium Drunkard Interview Posted on October 8, 2026 October 6, 2026 In an album as lyrically economic as the startlingly beautiful Cyano , the latest solo release from Emily A.
